items.heading: Lu Pulu
details: Key ingredients: corned beef, taro leaves, coconut cream
Wrap corned beef and onion in taro leaves.
Pour coconut cream over the wrapped bundles.
Bake or steam until the leaves are tender and infused with cream.
Serve warm with rice or root vegetables.

items.heading: Ota Ika
details: Key ingredients: raw fish, coconut cream, lime, vegetables
Dice raw fish and cure it in fresh lime juice.
Drain excess liquid and mix in coconut cream.
Add diced tomato, cucumber and onion.
Chill briefly and serve cold.
